native_only_preservation.reachability: Scoped crates search found definitions, inline tests and lib re-export only; no Markdown or CLI call found.
native_only_preservation.details: Native rust:crates/ice-tui/src/latex.rs:141-328 exposes render_latex/is_latex/strip_latex; scoped crates search found only definitions/tests and lib.rs108 re-export, not Markdown or CLI calls, so it must not be counted as active Markdown math rendering. Preserve these extra library APIs, but document their limits: symbol/fraction conversion occurs even when use_unicode=false; fallback_ascii is unused; max_width uses byte length/slice and can panic on multibyte cut; find_matching_brace uses scalar indices returned into byte slices, so Unicode text commands can also fail. Naive symbol replacement order can transform prefix commands such as subset before subseteq. Inline math Event arms in Markdown do not enable the parser math option.
native_only_preservation.recommendation: Retain these native-only library APIs, but do not count them as active Markdown math rendering. Repair byte/scalar safety before broader integration; treat such hardening separately from TS table-style parity.
